visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a vibrant light blue sweatshirt, stands in a modern kitchen with white cabinets. She looks directly into the camera with an expressive face, gesturing with her hands as she speaks. A colorful Instagram logo and Chinese text appear as overlays. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Quick, rapid-fire screen captures of various cooking videos from a mobile interface are shown, featuring close-ups of food being prepared and simmering in pots. The woman briefly reappears, pointing at the camera. (3) The scene shifts to a fast-motion sequence of the woman's hands, wearing black gloves, vigorously chopping red tomatoes, a white onion, and a green cabbage on a wooden cutting board. Text labels indicating ingredient names and quantities appear next to the food. (4) In the kitchen, the woman uses a spatula to sauté sliced onions and tomatoes in a shallow white pan on a black stovetop. A large red pot filled with simmering liquid sits on the adjacent burner. She then transfers the sautéed vegetables from the pan into the red pot. (5) She picks up a blue plastic bottle labeled with 'iCOI', opens it, and pours the clear liquid into the red pot. She then takes a direct sip from the bottle. (6) The woman adds a handful of white mushrooms and raw chicken pieces into the pot, followed by several large handfuls of chopped green cabbage, which eventually overflows the pot before she places a lid on it. (7) Finally, the woman is seated on a grey sofa in a living room, holding a white bowl filled with the cooked vegetable and chicken soup. She uses wooden chopsticks to pick up ingredients and eat, showing a thumbs-up and smiling with satisfaction. Soft toy pillows are visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in a fast, energetic, and high-pitched tone, accompanied by an upbeat electronic BGM with a strong, rhythmic beat. (2) A series of rapid 'whoosh' and 'click' sound effects punctuate the transitions between short clips. (3) A sequence of very fast, percussive 'chop-chop-chop' sound effects corresponds to the vegetable preparation. (4) A sizzling 'tsss' sound of sautéing is heard, followed by the female voice explaining the process over the continuous BGM. (5) A clear 'glug-glug' liquid pouring sound is heard as the coconut water is added, followed by a slight 'click' of the bottle. (6) A sharp 'whistle' sound effect and a short variety-show laugh track/male voice clip are inserted for comedic effect. (7) The female voice continues with a relaxed, satisfied tone while eating, featuring soft 'slurping' and 'crunching' foley sounds. The BGM remains upbeat until the final 'ding' sound effect at the end.

The creator combines social media trends with her own twist to provide an engaging and educational experience for viewers interested in weight loss or healthy eating.
